decisionLog.decision: Option A approved: expose pending/failure/freshness state and offer explicit same-item Resume/Send now. No automatic retries or resumption after errors, Stop, or reconnect.

Same-item Resume must run existing compaction restoration before steering the queued item. Normal idle gaps are labelled Pending/session idle rather than failed/paused. Verification leaves the pre-existing WaitDone test-fixture race untouched; no live server restart or reported ARC-session mutation is part of this change.
